post.description: Before uploading, say the file's fingerprint. When the server already holds that content (anyone's), it asks for the SHA-256 of a few random ranges of the file; a right answer to POST /api/claims/{claim_id} adds the file without sending it. The same checks as an upload come first: a file over files.max_file_bytes, or one that would pass your quota, is a 409. Ten minutes to answer.
